manual_derivations.result: Smooth bounded centroid correction with positive signal scale; dimensions and joint-boost covariance. Engineering choice, not a measured mesh-quality result.
Quintic taper endpoint value/first/second derivative joins; instantaneous continuous wall-relative velocity. Explicit steps still require inside checks.
Acyclic W then cvel/Vdot/Cdot then raw/tangent stage evaluation; Cdot holds a fixed, no Wdot inside instantaneous geometry derivative.
Different Euler-predicted and Heun-corrected generator positions and actual geometries; one correction per raw increment at old/P tangent metrics.
Predictor uses VP, corrector uses VH, owner samples use QP/VP and CP*aP; signed shared sweeps and no final projection.
Conditional augmented-state Taylor expansion includes W_t+W_r*W+W_Y*F; predictor/corrector GCL defects O(h^2)/O(h^3) on bounded smooth graphs.
Quadratic continuous extension reaches rH, not rP; predictor-only face presence is not dense-path physical coverage.
